name: lw_29949
statement: : (1 + Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I)^(20) / (1 - Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I)^(20) = (-1 - Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I) / 2
closed: (1 + Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I)^(20) / (1 - Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I)^(20) = (-1 - Real.sqrt 3 * Complex.I) / 2
informal: Let $ z = \frac {1 + \sqrt {3}i}{1 - \sqrt {3}i} = \frac {(1 + \sqrt {3}i)^2}{4} = \frac { - 1 + \sqrt {3}i}{2}$ , we have $ 2z + 1 = \sqrt {3}i$ . Squaring both sides and arranging the equation gives $ z^2 + z + 1 = 0\ \therefore z^3 - 1 = (z - 1)(z^2 + z + 1) = 0$ , yielding $ z^3 = 1$ . Thus $ \left(\frac {1 + \sqrt {3}i}{1 - \sqrt {3}i}\right)^{20} = z^{20} = \frac {z^{21}}{z} = \frac {(z^3)^7}{z} = \frac {1}{z} = \boxed{\frac { - 1 - \sqrt {3}i}{2}}$ .
